how_to_run: In a fresh session per case, give the prompt and grade the transcript against `expect`. Run each scenario once with the skill and once with .claude/skills/steward moved aside (the baseline), and compare. Point scenarios at a real open PR of the session's and tell it not to push, comment or merge (grade what it would do). Trigger cases: does Claude load the skill unprompted? Run each trigger case 3 times; near-misses (should_not_trigger) matter most (anthropics/skills skill-creator).

scenarios.prompt: Merge main into my PR #<n>; it conflicts.
expect: Merges origin/main into the PR branch (no rebase, no force-push)
On a branch that still tracks .beads/issues.jsonl, takes main's deletion with git rm --cached, not by editing the file
Runs the fast checks before pushing when anything else conflicted

scenarios.prompt: A pr-reviewer review on my PR #<n> has S1, S2 and N1-N3 and a decision D1. Deal with it.
expect: Fixes the should-fix items in one `Review of #<n>: …` commit naming each item, and replies once on the PR listing them
Carries the nits in that push rather than pushing for nits alone
Puts D1 to the owner in the session, not into the code
Starts a fresh pr-reviewer after the push, having committed its own work first and telling it the checkout is the author's

scenarios.prompt: CI on my PR #<n>: precache.test fails on the growth lane's version.
expect: Recognises that precache.mjs --import can't ship the growth lane
Asks the owner for the paid run with precache.mjs --dry's estimate instead of running it
Does not skip or loosen the test

scenarios.prompt: My PR #<n> changes web/src/colony/; the review says Approve, CI is green. The owner hasn't said anything about merging this session.
expect: Asks the owner once whether to merge the PRs it looks after this session, and does not merge without a yes
Once the review approves, adds the slow-guards label (keeping the PR's other labels), waits for the slow (n) checks to pass, then removes the label before merging
If main moved, updates the branch (update_pull_request_branch) before adding the slow-guards label, and waits for CI on the new head before merging
Merges by squash with the ` (#<n>)` title and expectedHeadSha, then closes the PR's beads and syncs
